Message from Smile Concierge: For Invisalign™ Aligner Cleaning Foam: 1. Dispense 1 full pump of foam inside each aligner, spreading it evenly. 2. Place the aligners back in your mouth and spit out any excess foam. 3. No rinsing is required. 4. Use up to 4 times daily. For at-home use, place the aligners inside an Invisalign Aligner Case, cover them with foam, and let them sit for up to 5 minutes. Rinse and brush before reinserting if desired.
